title: Economy Game
statementMd:
Kolya is developing an economy simulator game. His most favourite part of the development process is in-game testing. Once he was entertained by the testing so much, that he found out his game-coin score become equal to $0$.

Kolya remembers that at the beginning of the game his game-coin score was equal to $*n*$ and that he have bought only some houses (for $1 234 567$ game-coins each), cars (for $123 456$ game-coins each) and computers (for $1 234$ game-coins each).

Kolya is now interested, whether he could have spent all of his initial $*n*$ game-coins buying only houses, cars and computers or there is a bug in the game. Formally, is there a triple of non-negative integers $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$ such that $*a* × 1 234 567 + *b* × 123 456 + *c* × 1 234 = *n*$?

Please help Kolya answer this question.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$) — Kolya's initial game-coin score.

## Output

Print "`YES`" (without quotes) if it's possible that Kolya spent all of his initial $*n*$ coins buying only houses, cars and computers. Otherwise print "`NO`" (without quotes).

## Note

In the first sample, one of the possible solutions is to buy one house, one car and one computer, spending $1 234 567 + 123 456 + 1234 = 1 359 257$ game-coins in total.
statementZhMd:
Kolya 正在开发一款经济模拟游戏。他最喜欢的开发环节是游戏内测试。有一次，他沉迷于测试，以至于发现自己的游戏币数量变成了 $0$。

Kolya 记得，游戏开始时他的游戏币数量是 $*n*$，并且他只购买过房屋（每栋需要 $1 234 567$ 枚游戏币）、汽车（每辆需要 $123 456$ 枚游戏币）和电脑（每台需要 $1 234$ 枚游戏币）。

现在，Kolya 想知道，他是否可能只购买房屋、汽车和电脑，恰好花光最初的 $*n*$ 枚游戏币，还是游戏中存在 bug。形式化地说，是否存在三个非负整数 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$，使得 $*a* × 1 234 567 + *b* × 123 456 + *c* × 1 234 = *n*$？

请帮助 Kolya 回答这个问题。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$）——Kolya 最初拥有的游戏币数量。

## 输出格式

如果 Kolya 可能只购买房屋、汽车和电脑，恰好花光最初的 $*n*$ 枚游戏币，则输出 `YES`（不含引号）。否则输出 `NO`（不含引号）。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一种可行方案是购买一栋房屋、一辆汽车和一台电脑，总共花费 $1 234 567 + 123 456 + 1234 = 1 359 257$ 枚游戏币。
